title: REGANT — TTMPC Integrated Member Profiling and Financial Decision Support System
description: A web-based decision support system for the Tubungan Teachers' Multi-Purpose Cooperative (TTMPC), combining cooperative operations management (loans, savings, membership) with ML-driven analytics (credit risk scoring, loan demand forecasting, MIGS scoring), serving both cooperative officers (desktop admin/staff portals) and members (mobile-friendly self-service).

colors.name: Bright interactive green (login / role-selection focus states, CTAs)

source: Read directly from TTMPC_THESIS/src/index.css and public/img/ttmpc logo.png — no live URL, no headless-Chrome crawl. This is the same real brand extraction used for the project's earlier /brag video (TTMPC_THESIS/brag-output/).
